key.name: cycle-profiles-key
key.description: Keyboard shortcut to cycle to the next saved strixctl profile. On ASUS ROG laptops the Fn+Q key often appears as XF86Launch1 — set this key to ["XF86Launch1"] to use it.

key.name: pill-enabled
key.description: Shows a small readout in the top bar, next to the clock. Its contents are selected with the pill-show-* keys below; the pill hides itself when none of them is enabled.

key.name: pill-show-freq
key.description: Fastest live core frequency, in GHz.

key.name: pill-show-power
key.description: Battery discharge in watts, or "AC" while running on mains.

key.name: pill-show-battery
key.description: Estimated remaining battery time (h:mm) at the current draw, or "AC" while running on mains.
